payload.name: pc-contrast-10
payload.description: Pure-logic guard: validates a raw list of records, each an object with exactly the keys code (string length 2..5) and enabled (exact boolean), and returns {ok, records} where records is the original list when valid or [] otherwise. No I/O, imports, host calls or upstream-validation assumption. Unapproved target-interface draft; activation requires Q1, human Q2 and typed-runner support.
